newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end lifeless holiday session mixed.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end lifeless holiday session mixed.

text.p: Italian stocks ended mixed around opening levels after a very thin session on Friday with many operators prolonging the Christmas break.
"Today we did nothing apart from a bit of book-squaring by the few operators around," one dealer said. Traded volume was estimated at a very low 250 billion lire.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.13 percent up at 10,501 but the Mib30 blue chip index ended down 0.01 percent at 15,670.

Fiat put on 0.91 percent to 4,235 lire and state-controlled telecoms holding Stet rose 1.08 percent to 6,845. Olivetti gained 0.84 percent to 529 lire and Banca Commerciale Italiana put on 1.46 percent to 2,775.

But among losers, energy group ENI slipped 0.39 percent to 7,950 lire, Montedison lost 1.25 percent to 1,030, food group Parmalat lost 3.77 percent to 2,300 and Pirelli Spa shed 0.74 percent to 2,800 lire.
